title: State versus path
hints: Imagine two routes between the same states.
Ask whether the measured quantity can depend on the route.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: $\Delta E$ depends solely on the initial and final states. Heat and work can change if the path changes.
statement:
Which listed quantity is a state function?

[_]{a}

choices: $\Delta V$ integrated against varying $P_\mathrm{ext}$ to obtain work
explanations: Internal energy is a state function.
Heat transfer depends on the path.
Different external pressures along paths alter the work.
